sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Vagy means 'or', and a waiter uses szeretne (the third-person polite form, no -k) to ask what you would like.

items.english: Would you like lemonade or a soft drink?

items.spanish: Jó napot kívánok! Itt az étlap.

sections.content: Szeretne has no -k ending because it's not 'I' asking — it's 'you' (polite/formal) or 'he/she'. Compare it to szeretnék, which always means 'I'.
